targets.outcome_quote: In conclusion, the present study demonstrated support for the direct replicability of emotion-related physiological changes in general and the nature of the psychophysiological response of a mixed emotional state in particular.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors give an overall concluding verdict supporting direct replicability. This overall verdict governs despite individual physiological-variable differences and smaller effects.
